title: Battle of Maniaki
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Maniaki", at revision 1370448784, opens: "The Battle of Maniaki was fought on May 20, 1825, in Maniaki, Greece between Egyptian forces led by Ibrahim Pasha and Greek forces led by Papaflessas." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3394852, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "fought 1825 between Egyptian and Greek forces". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
